indicators.name: Real manufacturing GVA growth
indicators.definition: Annual percentage change in real Gross Value Added of manufacturing at constant prices in the current National Accounts series.
indicators.calculation_method: Use the source-defined annual real manufacturing GVA growth rate. Do not recompute from mixed-vintage levels without recording the vintage and base series.

version_history.definition: Annual percentage change in real manufacturing GVA using the current National Accounts series.
version_history.numerator: current-period real manufacturing GVA minus prior-period real manufacturing GVA
version_history.methodology: MoSPI National Accounts methodology, current base 2022-23
version_history.comparability_status: Use source-defined current-series back-series and preserve revisions.

indicators.name: Manufacturing share of GVA
indicators.definition: Manufacturing GVA as a percentage of total GVA for the same reference period and price basis.
indicators.calculation_method: Manufacturing GVA / total GVA * 100, using the same NAS vintage, price basis and reference period for numerator and denominator.

version_history.definition: Manufacturing GVA divided by total GVA for the same period and price basis.
version_history.methodology: Derived from MoSPI National Accounts series.
version_history.comparability_status: Derived metric; preserve NAS revisions and price basis.

indicators.name: Manufacturing Index of Industrial Production
indicators.definition: Monthly manufacturing sector index measuring changes in the volume of production relative to the IIP base period.
indicators.calculation_method: Use the MoSPI published manufacturing sector IIP index. Preserve quick estimate, revised and final vintages separately.

version_history.definition: Manufacturing sector IIP under the new 2022-23 base series.
version_history.methodology: MoSPI IIP new series, base 2022-23, NIC 2008 classification.
version_history.comparability_status: Do not silently splice with the superseded 2011-12 series. Latest observation is provisional and prior observations are subject to revision.

indicators.name: Registered manufacturing GVA
indicators.definition: Gross Value Added reported for factories covered by the Annual Survey of Industries, at the published national or State aggregation level.

baseline.availability: ASI historical releases subject to series coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Use published ASI GVA aggregate for the selected geography and reference year. Do not treat ASI GVA as total manufacturing GVA because ASI covers registered organised manufacturing.

version_history.definition: Published ASI gross value added for registered organised manufacturing factories.
version_history.methodology: MoSPI Annual Survey of Industries methodology.
version_history.comparability_status: Coverage is registered organised manufacturing; retain ASI methodology and coverage notes.

indicators.name: Registered manufacturing persons engaged
indicators.definition: Total persons engaged in factories covered by the Annual Survey of Industries, at the published national or State aggregation level.

baseline.availability: ASI historical releases subject to series coverage

indicators.calculation_method: Use published ASI persons-engaged aggregate for the selected geography and reference year.

version_history.definition: Total persons engaged in ASI-covered factories.
version_history.methodology: MoSPI Annual Survey of Industries methodology and published summary tables.
version_history.comparability_status: Registered organised manufacturing only; not a measure of total manufacturing employment.

indicators.name: Manufacturing share of workers
indicators.definition: Share of workers classified in manufacturing industry divisions 10-33 under NIC 2008 among workers measured by the specified PLFS activity-status concept.
indicators.calculation_method: Use PLFS published industry-of-work estimates for NIC 2008 manufacturing divisions 10-33. Preserve the activity-status concept and survey design for each vintage.

version_history.definition: PLFS worker share associated with manufacturing industry divisions 10-33 under NIC 2008.
version_history.numerator: workers in manufacturing divisions 10-33 under the specified PLFS concept
version_history.denominator: workers in the same PLFS universe
version_history.methodology: PLFS annual survey concepts, NIC 2008 industry classification for the historical series.
version_history.comparability_status: Review the 2025 sampling-design change before comparing post-2025 estimates with earlier annual estimates.

indicators.name: Manufacturing value added, international comparison
indicators.definition: Manufacturing value added reported by UNIDO for the manufacturing sector under ISIC Revision 4, using the country-year observation and source-defined monetary unit.
indicators.unit: current national currency or USD, source-defined
indicators.calculation_method: Use UNIDO INDSTAT Rev. 4 manufacturing value-added observations for country-year comparisons. Apply no cross-country conversion beyond the source-defined series until peer-basket and currency methodology are approved.

version_history.definition: UNIDO INDSTAT Rev. 4 manufacturing value added under ISIC Rev. 4.
version_history.methodology: UNIDO INDSTAT Rev. 4; official national and regional statistical sources harmonised to ISIC Rev. 4.
version_history.comparability_status: Country-year coverage varies; final peer basket methodology remains unresolved.
